- (1,1)→(5,5), (1,2)→(5,4)
- (2,2)→(4,4), (2,3)→(4,3)
- (3,3)→(3,3), (3,4)→(3,2), (3,5)→(3,1)
- (4,5)→(2,1), (5,5)→(1,1)

The rotated board has dark squares at: (1,1), (2,1), (3,1), (3,2), (3,3), (4,3), (4,4), (5,4), (5,5).

This pattern — two single dark squares at the top left, a three-square row, then a diagonal step down to the bottom right — matches Board E exactly.

\boxed{E}
